title: 第21章 发神经的男人第22章 我结婚了
lines: 第21章发神经的男人
面对夏天的怒吼，权天睿显得很淡定。
“我睡自己的老婆，那是很神圣的事情。”
神圣个鬼……
夏天在心里不断腹诽，这个男人，总有把黑的说成白的本事。
“走，去吃饭。”
她觉得在这样跟他讨论下去，自己的脸皮都快没了。
这个男人就是一个大写污！
见夏天要吃饭，权天睿也没有在调戏她，只是起身，直接抱着夏天就朝主卧走。
“我可以自己走，你放我下来。”
被他这样抱着下楼，虽然这几日都是这么过的，但是现在脚好的差不多了，她也是可以慢慢的走下去的。
毕竟老是被他这样抱来抱去的，她也是会不好意思的，毕竟景园里可不止他们两个人。
桂嫂跟李管家，加上其他佣人，具体人数夏天不知道，不过她却是知道，肯定不会少。
她脸皮又不像是某人一样那么厚。
对于夏天的拒绝，权天睿是无视的。
直接抱着她就朝主卧走，夏天瞪着抱着自己的这个男人。
“你放我下来，不是去吃饭吗？你抱我去房间做什么？”
这个男人，不会是又想对自己做点什么吧！方才在书房差点就擦枪走火，这是打算秋后算账？
“权天睿，我是个伤员，伤员你懂不懂？”
权天睿眉头挑的老高，看着夏天抓狂的样子，越是觉得她可爱无比。
直接将夏天抱进了衣帽间，“换一件衣服，我们出去吃饭。”
“…………”所以说，是她自己想多了？
看着眼前的这些衣服，夏天恨不得将脸埋进去，简直，太丢脸了，自己的思想怎么能那么龌蹉？
他自然将夏天羞愧到不行的模样看在眼里，眼眸之中的笑意更浓了。
但是又怕她的脚不方便，索性他自己直接动手，给她找来衣服。
“换这个吧！”
对此，夏天没有意见，低着脑袋，接过衣服。
夏天抱着衣服，见权天睿没有要走的意思，微囧。这个男人不会是打算看着她换衣服吧！光是想想都觉得好羞人好不好。
“你先出去。”
权天睿双手环胸，斜斜的依靠在门框上，一点要走的意思都没有。
“你是我老婆，害羞什么，你身上我哪里没有看过？”
意思是这个意思，但是那不一样好不好，这个男人到底有没有一点男女有别的意识没有？
唔……如果权天睿知道她心里这个想法的话，肯定会直接了当的说。
跟自己老婆在一起还在乎这个，那岂不是不用怀宝宝了？
“不行，你出去。”
这个男人，逮着机会的占便宜。
瞧着夏天那娇羞的模样，权天睿心知自己要是不出去，今晚这顿饭怕是不用吃了。
“那你有事情直接叫我。”
临走之前，权天睿还是有些不放心，所以交代到。
夏天赶紧应了一声，将权天睿这头大色狼给打发了。

Chapter 21 The crazy man
Facing Xia Tian's roar, Quan Tianrui seemed very calm.
"I sleep with my own wife, it's a very sacred thing."
Holy ghost...
Xia Tian kept criticizing in his heart, this man always has the ability to turn black into white.
"Let's go eat."
She felt that if she continued to discuss it with him like this, she would almost lose her face.
This man is a filthy man!
Seeing that Xia Tian was about to eat, Quan Tianrui didn't tease her, he just stood up, hugged Xia Tian and walked towards the master bedroom.
"I can walk by myself, you put me down."
Being carried downstairs by him like this, although she had been living like this for the past few days, her feet were almost healed now and she could walk down slowly.
After all, she would be embarrassed to be hugged back and forth by him all the time. After all, there were more than just the two of them in the garden.
Xia Tian didn't know the exact number of Sister Gui, Housekeeper Li, and other servants, but she knew that there would definitely be no less.
She's not as thick-skinned as someone else.
Quan Tianrui ignored Xia Tian's rejection.
He hugged her directly and walked towards the master bedroom. Xia Tian stared at the man holding him.
"Aren't you going to eat when you put me down? Why are you carrying me to the room?"
Could this man want to do something to himself again? The gun almost went off in the study just now. Are you planning to settle the score later?
"Quan Tianrui, I am a wounded person. Do you understand the wounded person?"
Quan Tianrui's brows were raised high. Seeing Xia Tian's crazy look, he found her even more adorable.
He carried Xia Tian directly into the cloakroom, "Change into some clothes, let's go out to eat."
"..." So, she is overthinking it?
Looking at the clothes in front of him, Xia Tian wanted to bury his face in them. It was so embarrassing. How could his thoughts be so dirty?
He naturally saw Xia Tian's extremely ashamed look in his eyes, and the smile in his eyes became even stronger.
But he was afraid that her feet would be inconvenient, so he simply went ahead and found clothes for her.
"Change this!"
Xia Tian had no objection to this, lowered his head and took the clothes.
Xia Tian hugged her clothes and felt slightly embarrassed when she saw that Quan Tianrui had no intention of leaving. Isn't this man planning to watch her change clothes? Just thinking about it makes me feel so embarrassed.
"You go out first."
Quan Tianrui crossed his arms across his chest and leaned on the door frame, showing no intention of leaving.
"You are my wife, why are you so shy? I haven't seen anything about you?"
That's what it means, but it's different, right? Does this man have any awareness of the difference between men and women?
Well...if Quan Tianrui knew what she was thinking, he would definitely say it directly.
If you still care about this when you are with your wife, doesn’t that mean you don’t have to have a baby?
"No, you get out."
This man seizes the opportunity to take advantage.
Looking at Xia Tian's shy look, Quan Tianrui knew that if he didn't go out, he might not have to eat this meal tonight.
"Then if you have anything to do, just call me."
Before leaving, Quan Tianrui was still a little worried, so he confessed.
"Yeah."
Xia Tian quickly responded and dismissed Quan Tianrui, the big pervert.
title_en: Chapter 21 The crazy man Chapter 22 I’m married
